value.syntax: # [doc = " The three forms of `memberkey`."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " All three are distinct in the tree even where two would describe the"] # [doc = " same key, because they do not mean the same thing: `a: 1` keys on the"] # [doc = " *text string* \"a\", while `a => 1` keys on whatever the type `a`"] # [doc = " denotes."] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub (crate) enum MemberKeyKind { # [doc = " `type1 S [\"^\" S] \"=>\"`: a key given as a type."] Type { # [doc = " The key type."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Boxed: a `type1` is the deepest node of the grammar, and the"] # [doc = " other two key forms are a name and a literal."] key : Box < Type1 > , # [doc = " Whether the cut marker `^` was written."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " A cut makes a failure to match the member's *value* a failure"] # [doc = " of the whole map, rather than a reason to try the next entry."] cut : bool , } , # [doc = " `bareword S \":\"`: a key given as a name, denoting that text string."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The colon form carries an implicit cut, which is why it is not the"] # [doc = " same node as a `Type` key that happens to hold a text literal."] Bareword (Name) , # [doc = " `value S \":\"`: a key given as a literal."] Value (Value) , }
